highlights.title: The KOSMOS orb on the big waits
highlights.line: Opening, updating and Kosmos+ sign-in now wait under the KOSMOS orb, and making an agent ends with its dots turning into a check.

highlights.title: Join codes that cannot be used say why
highlights.line: When a join code is for another address or a company with no free seat, Kosmos now says what to do instead of asking you to try again.

highlights.title: A half-typed new agent says why it is back
highlights.line: If Create agent sends you to Settings to connect a model, New agent keeps what you typed for 30 minutes and offers Start over.

highlights.title: Use short names keeps names you typed
highlights.line: When you make a team, Use short names now keeps a name you typed in a row.

highlights.title: A download that cannot start says why
highlights.line: When the Mac app cannot start a download, it now says why instead of nothing happening.
